title: German Oaty Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful German-inspired pilaf dish made with oaty goodness.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add savory and cook for 1 minute.
Add grains and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add pilaf seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add oaty and water to the saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.
